text:
[{"word":"speaking","pronun":"[ˈspiːkɪŋ]","translation":"n. 说话；演讲
v. 讲（speak的ing形式）
adj. 演讲的；富于表情的，雄辩的","audio":"speaking.mp3"},{"word":"spelling","pronun":"[ˈspelɪŋ]","translation":"n. 拼写；拼字；拼法
v. 拼写；意味着（spell的ing形式）；迷住","audio":"spelling.mp3"},{"word":"vocabulary","pronun":"[vəˈkæbjəleri]","translation":"n. 词汇；词表；词汇量","audio":"vocabulary.mp3"},{"word":"writing","pronun":"[ˈraɪtɪŋ]","translation":"n. 书写；作品；著作；[法] 笔迹
v. 书写（write的ing形式）","audio":"writing.mp3"},{"word":"beach","pronun":"[biːtʃ]","translation":"n. 海滩；湖滨
vt. 将…拖上岸
vi. 搁浅；定居","audio":"beach.mp3"},{"word":"branch","pronun":"[bræntʃ]","translation":"n. 树枝，分枝；分部；支流
vt. 分支；出现分歧
vi. 分支；出现分歧","audio":"branch.mp3"},{"word":"cave","pronun":"[keɪv]","translation":"n. 洞穴，窑洞
vi. 凹陷，塌落；投降
vt. 使凹陷，使塌落；在…挖洞穴","audio":"cave.mp3"},{"word":"coast","pronun":"[koʊst]","translation":"n. 海岸；滑坡
vt. 沿…岸航行
vi. 滑行；沿岸航行","audio":"coast.mp3"},{"word":"earth","pronun":"[ɜːrθ]","translation":"n. 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴
vt. 把（电线）[电] 接地；盖（土）；追赶入洞穴
vi. 躲进地洞","audio":"earth.mp3"},{"word":"egg","pronun":"[eɡ]","translation":"n. 蛋；卵子；家伙；鸡蛋
vt. 煽动；怂恿","audio":"egg.mp3"},{"word":"farm","pronun":"[fɑːrm]","translation":"n. 农场；农家；畜牧场
vt. 养殖；耕种；佃出（土地）
vi. 种田，务农；经营农场","audio":"farm.mp3"},{"word":"farmer","pronun":"[ˈfɑːrmər]","translation":"n. 农夫，农民","audio":"farmer.mp3"},{"word":"field","pronun":"[fiːld]","translation":"n. 领域；牧场；旷野；战场；运动场
adj. 扫描场；田赛的；野生的
vt. 把暴晒于场上；使上场
vi. 担任场外队员","audio":"field.mp3"},{"word":"fish","pronun":"[fɪʃ]","translation":"n. 鱼，鱼类
vt. 钓鱼，捕鱼；搜寻
vi. 捕鱼，钓鱼；用钩捞取","audio":"fish.mp3"},{"word":"flower","pronun":"[ˈflaʊər]","translation":"n. 花；精华；开花植物
vt. 使开花；用花装饰
vi. 成熟，发育；开花；繁荣；旺盛","audio":"flower.mp3"},{"word":"forest","pronun":"[ˈfɔːrɪst]","translation":"n. 森林
vt. 植树于，使成为森林","audio":"forest.mp3"},{"word":"garden","pronun":"[ˈɡɑːrdn]","translation":"n. 花园；菜园
vt. 栽培花木
vi. 从事园艺；在园中种植","audio":"garden.mp3"},{"word":"grass","pronun":"[ɡræs]","translation":"n. 草；草地，草坪
vt. 放牧；使……长满草；使……吃草
vi. 长草","audio":"grass.mp3"},{"word":"hill","pronun":"[hɪl]","translation":"n. 小山；丘陵；斜坡；山冈","audio":"hill.mp3"},{"word":"island","pronun":"[ˈaɪlənd]","translation":"n. 岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物
adj. 岛的
vt. 孤立；使成岛状","audio":"island.mp3"}]
